sourceNotes.rawContent: Royally stunning and utterly unique — this Kashmiri bracelet watch features elaborate square kundan frames with green enamel accents and sparkling CZ stones, connected by triple gold chains with jingling ghungroo bells on both ends. The pearlescent white quartz dial adds a regal finishing touch. A true showstopper for brides, bridesmaids, and every woman who loves wearing heritage with pride.
